verdict.rationale: The web UI accepts multiple files dropped at once and converts them together ("drop your files... click Convert"). The API plan advertises unlimited concurrent conversions, and a CLI exists. That points to thin, implied multi-item processing, but no documented batch operation or bulk endpoint. Missing for 10: an explicit batch or bulk conversion API or CLI command, documentation of multi-file job handling and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
